claim_boundary: This is a coverage and conformance benchmark, not a certification or compliance claim.

requirements.requirement: Raw SBOM documents conform to the official JSON schema
requirements.evidence: Official schema validation of canonical and modified SBOM fixtures

requirements.requirement: Component inventory has typed components, versions and unique BOM references
requirements.evidence: data/synthetic/supply_chain_poc/sbom/*.json

requirements.requirement: Vulnerabilities reference components through affects/ref
requirements.evidence: SC-004 raw SBOM and schema validation

requirements.requirement: Vulnerability exploitability analysis is represented in a standard machine-readable structure
requirements.evidence: VEX records exist as separate CSV; no CycloneDX analysis object is emitted

requirements.requirement: BOM signature can be verified
requirements.evidence: No cryptographic CycloneDX signature in the synthetic fixtures

requirements.requirement: Artifact is identified by cryptographic digest
requirements.evidence: trusted_hash and observed_hash

requirements.requirement: Build provenance describes builder, process and inputs
requirements.evidence: No SLSA provenance attestation is generated

requirements.requirement: Provenance authenticity is verifiable
requirements.evidence: Signature observations are synthetic booleans, not signed provenance

requirements.requirement: Source provenance and source-control properties are recorded
requirements.evidence: Dataset does not model source revisions or source attestations

requirements.requirement: Build platform and build isolation properties are recorded
requirements.evidence: Dataset does not model a real build platform

requirements.requirement: Protect firmware authenticity and integrity against unauthorized change
requirements.evidence: Trusted hash, signature, root and vendor observations are modelled; enforcement hardware is not

requirements.requirement: Detect unauthorized firmware or critical-data changes
requirements.evidence: Hash mismatch, signature/root failure, unexpected component and rollback cases

requirements.requirement: Prevent or identify unauthorized rollback
requirements.evidence: Observed/approved versions and rollback_authorized

requirements.requirement: Recover firmware and critical data to an authorised state
requirements.evidence: Recovery is outside the PoC safety boundary

requirements.requirement: Verify software release integrity
requirements.evidence: Synthetic hash and signature evidence; no production release process

requirements.requirement: Archive and protect releases and supporting integrity data
requirements.evidence: Trusted references and dataset hashes are retained; no organisational archive control

requirements.requirement: Collect and share provenance data for releases
requirements.evidence: No standard provenance attestation

requirements.requirement: Assess and track third-party components
requirements.evidence: SBOM, component, vendor and vulnerability observations

requirements.requirement: Identify and confirm vulnerabilities
requirements.evidence: Vulnerability presence, applicability, count, severity and VEX reference data

requirements.requirement: Assess, prioritise and remediate vulnerabilities
requirements.evidence: Severity/applicability risk assessment exists; remediation workflow is outside scope
